rules.heading: Manager notes file
rules.quote: holds, the manager writes in `status/manager.txt` beside it (the manager fence
rules.says: The manager writes its notes in status/manager.txt beside the status page, as plain text with one item to a line, and the main thread may write that one file as it writes the page.

rules.heading: Manager notes file
rules.quote: one item to a line, the plan's outcome in the owner's terms (`Outcome:`)
rules.says: The manager notes carry the plan's outcome in the owner's terms on an `Outcome:` line.

rules.heading: Manager notes file
rules.quote: each explanation still standing and each ruled out, with the evidence after ` | `
rules.says: The manager notes list each explanation still standing (`Explanation standing:`) and each ruled out (`Explanation ruled out:`) as its own line, with the evidence after ` | `.

rules.heading: Manager notes file
rules.quote: every decision with its reason (`Decision:`), the next move (`Next:`)
rules.says: The manager notes record every decision with its reason on a `Decision:` line and the next move on a `Next:` line.

rules.heading: Manager notes file
rules.quote: and a line such as `Found 41.3 queued: note` for each `Found:` line of a report, keyed by its
rules.says: For each `Found:` line of a report the manager writes a line such as `Found 41.3 queued: note`, keyed by its step and its place among that step's Found lines; `Found 41.*` sorts a whole step at once, and a line for one finding beats it.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The page renders these under their own headings, with the Found lines in three groups, put right, stopping the plan, and queued for the next plan, and the lines not yet sorted
rules.says: The status page shows manager notes under their own headings and sorts each Found line into put right, stopping the plan, or queued for the next plan, with unsorted lines counted near the top and in the status print, so the manager sorts each finding as it lands and an unsorted one cannot hide.
rules.enforcer: managerNotes, sortFound and statusPage in report.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The outcome falls back on the plan's first goal until the manager writes one.
rules.says: The status page's outcome line defaults to the plan's first goal until the manager writes an Outcome line in status/manager.txt.
rules.enforcer: managerNotes, sortFound and statusPage in report.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **After a compaction the main thread's first read is that page**, held the way the doctrine's read is:
rules.says: After a compaction the main thread's first read must be the whole status page (a Read result returned after the due marker and covering the whole file); until then every main-thread call but a read and the status is refused, except TaskStop, and nothing is held while the page does not yet exist; the refusal does not latch.
rules.enforcer: markPageDue (SessionStart source compact) and pageGate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A finding is recorded for the next plan, and the next plan answers it line by line.** A finding that is not put right and does not stop the plan goes in
rules.says: A finding that is not put right and does not stop the plan is recorded as one line in the '## Found queue' section of the NOTES.md of the repository it is about, opening with a key like Q-TAG-3 using that repository's tag, while the hub's own findings are files in found/.
rules.enforcer: foundAnsweredProblem in hook-dispatch.mjs (called by plan-guard.mjs at ExitPlanMode)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Enforced by:* `foundAnsweredProblem` in `hook-dispatch.mjs`, which
rules.says: A plan whose Files names a repository with queued findings must have a '## Found answered' section with one line per finding, opening with its key and then 'fixed in step N', 'carried to step N', 'still queued' or 'dropped', the last two with a reason of ten characters or more, or ExitPlanMode is refused.
rules.enforcer: foundAnsweredProblem in hook-dispatch.mjs, called by plan-guard.mjs at ExitPlanMode

rules.heading: Found answered check
rules.quote: repository (by a label `labelNames` accepts) with queued findings is refused
rules.says: A plan names a repository in its Files by a label that labelNames accepts, and only a repository named that way is checked for queued findings.
rules.enforcer: foundAnsweredProblem in hook-dispatch.mjs, called by plan-guard.mjs at ExitPlanMode

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A fix is code that runs or a case that fails when the mistake returns, and a paragraph, a lesson or a check on wording is no fix.
rules.says: A fix means code that runs or a case that fails when the mistake returns; a paragraph, a lesson or a check on wording does not count as a fix.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A repository with no queue,
rules.says: A repository with no found queue, or a plan whose Files names no repository, is not judged by the Found answered check.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The queue is written by an
rules.says: The found queue is written by an agent, in a step of a plan whose Files names the file, because the main thread writes no repository file.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A plan accounts for the roadmap, one bullet to an item.** A plan that sends
rules.says: A plan that sends agents into a repository its Files names must have a '## Roadmap' section with one bullet for each open roadmap item (each '- [ ] **Title**' bullet under '## Next capability release' in that repository's NOTES.md) of every repository the Files names.
rules.enforcer: roadmapProblem in hook-dispatch.mjs, called by plan-guard.mjs at ExitPlanMode and by plan-guard.mjs --check

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Each bullet opens with the item's key, its decision
rules.says: Each Roadmap bullet opens with the item's key (its decision number, else its title), then the word 'in' or 'out', then a reason of ten characters or more, for example '012 out: the plan leaves it for a later plan'.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A repository
rules.says: A repository that keeps no roadmap is not asked for a Roadmap section.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The section forces a statement and cannot judge that it is true.
rules.says: The Roadmap check runs at ExitPlanMode and when plan-guard.mjs --check is run before the talk (rule 4), its refusal lists the items with no bullet, and it sets no latch (rule 14).

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A plan that marks an item in has read the commit log first.** A line in the
rules.says: A plan that marks a Roadmap item 'in' must rest on a read, made by the session after the plan file was first written, of `git -C <the repository> log` naming the repository's production branch and its staging branch (main and staging for an app), because a line in the notes is not the state of the app.
rules.enforcer: shippedCheckProblem in hook-dispatch.mjs, called by plan-guard.mjs at ExitPlanMode and plan-guard.mjs --check

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: its `## Shipped check`
rules.says: A plan with items marked 'in' has a '## Shipped check' section with one line per such item, giving the item's key and a colon, then 'not shipped, read against main and staging on <the date>' or, where the log shows it, 'shipped on <branch> by "<the commit's subject>"' quoted from the log.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: which marks it as work already done: shipped work is marked
rules.says: Work the log shows as shipped is marked 'out' in the Roadmap and not built.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The section forces the read and the
rules.says: The Shipped check refusal names the missing read and each missing or wrong line, and sets no latch.

rules.heading: Shipped check enforcement point
rules.quote: `shippedCheckProblem` in `hook-dispatch.mjs` (LESSONS §423), called by
rules.says: The Shipped check runs both at ExitPlanMode and when plan-guard.mjs --check is run, so a plan that marks an item in is refused at either point until the read and the Shipped check lines are present and right.
rules.enforcer: shippedCheckProblem in hook-dispatch.mjs, called by plan-guard.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **Work running in the background is the work.** While a background command
rules.says: While a background command or a workflow the session started is still running, the session does not end its turn but stays and acts on each result as it lands, and a declared stop does not excuse it.
rules.enforcer: stop-guard.mjs (refuses every stop while a task the session launched has not ended; LESSONS §381)
rules.live_quote: Start no process you will not manage, and confirm it ended by the resource, not the process list. / IF YOU START IT, YOU OWN IT UNTIL IT IS DEAD. A background command, a watcher, a poll loop, a browser, a subagent.
rules.missing: Live text says own and confirm a started process is gone; it does not say the session must not end its turn while it runs, must act on each result as it lands, or that a declared stop is no excuse. stop-guard is a shell.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A running agent does not hold the turn.** The harness's completion
rules.says: After sending an agent the main thread ends its turn, because the harness's completion notification brings the session back when the agent ends, and staying in the turn to wait costs a turn of the main thread's model per wait.
rules.enforcer: stop-guard.mjs, which does not count a running agent among the tasks that hold a stop

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The wait is gone from
rules.says: The wait is no longer used: `report.mjs --wait` still exists and the manager fence (rule 13) still passes it, but nothing asks the session to run it.

rules.heading: A running agent does not hold the turn
rules.quote: `stop-guard.mjs`, which does not count a running agent among the tasks that
rules.says: A running agent is not counted among the tasks that hold a stop, so the session may end its turn while an agent runs, unlike a background command or workflow it launched.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A background run is announced, a flagged agent is read, and the wait is
rules.says: An agent's background run is announced: its progress note, written before the launch, must name a label and the output file's full path and carry no time (the time is read from the file's write time), and where the command names no output file the note must be written again with the path the launch printed, with every other call of that agent refused meanwhile.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `report.mjs` prints for a flagged running agent the last line of the newest
rules.says: For a flagged running agent the status prints the last line of the newest file in the step's scratch folder (else of the output file its note names) and its last tool result, so the flagged agent is read.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `hook-dispatch.mjs` refuses the wait between
rules.says: The wait between statuses is refused while any running agent is flagged, the refusal names the status as the read to make and sets no latch, and each of the two reads is printed only when new or changed since the last status.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **An agent that ended its turn on its own background run is running, not
rules.says: An agent counts as ended only by its hand-back call, an interruption or a failure, never by the harness's completion notice, so an agent that ended its turn on its own background run is treated as running by the status, the wait, the pointer, the review gate and the stop guard.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **The wait ends when the owner writes.** `report.mjs --wait` returns within
rules.says: `report.mjs --wait` returns within its poll interval when an owner message is written to the transcript after the wait began, its first line saying an owner message arrived at its California time and the message printed under it, with an agent's end and a progress note's change remaining its other conditions.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 3. **Reply to every point in a message from the owner.**
rules.says: A session replies to every point in a message from the owner.
rules.enforcer: the correction check in hook-dispatch.mjs and pending-guard.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A message saying
rules.says: A message saying something was done wrong is a full stop: the session answers it and runs nothing else in that turn, and does not work through corrections on its own reading of what was meant.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Enforced by:* the correction check in `hook-dispatch.mjs`. At
rules.says: A message counts as a go message only when its LAST word (case and punctuation set aside) is one of the declared go-words (go, ok, continue, approved, yes); the check records this at UserPromptSubmit and re-reads the owner's newest message from the transcript at every PreToolUse, including messages delivered between tool calls.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The list is the owner's to extend, and a
rules.says: The go-word list is the owner's to extend and a session never adds to it.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Every other message is a correction. While a
rules.says: Every message that does not end in a go-word is a correction, and while a correction is the newest owner message every new start on the main thread is held, except the status command, TaskStop and a read of the record (the approved plan and plans folder, the session scratchpad, the doctrine and lessons, each repo's notes and plan pointers, the session's transcript) as rule 13's fence classifies one.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: so a question one file
rules.says: A question one file answers is answered from that file in the turn it is asked, without waiting for a go-word.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: An agent dispatch, a write, a
rules.says: While a correction stands, an agent dispatch, a write, a SendUserFile and a read of anything outside the record stay held, and the refusal says what passes.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **Where the plan carries a review step (rule 2),
rules.says: Where the plan carries a review step, approved work goes on after one review with no go-word: the Standing review step passes, and so does the step a review cleared that began after the correction was typed, because that review read the correction before it judged the move.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A correction aimed at the very step a
rules.says: A correction aimed at the very step a review cleared earlier does not reach the new step unseen: the new reviewer reads it and refuses or clears.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The refusal names this rule,
rules.says: The correction refusal names this rule, prints the list of what passes, never quotes a message from the owner, and does not latch (rule 14), because the owner's next message lifts it.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Agents are not held by a correction, and the plan fence holds them (rule 13).
rules.says: Agents are not held by a correction; the plan fence (rule 13) holds them instead.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The entry to plan mode passes the hold, and so, while plan mode is on, do a
rules.says: The entry to plan mode passes the correction hold, and while plan mode is on so do a write of the plan file and the plan check, as the status command does, so that a correction asking for a plan does not hold the call that makes it.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The line printed at each message says what passes in the form that fits it:
rules.says: The line printed at each owner message states what passes: after a go-word held work may go, under a correction the list above, and under the word stop with no go-word at its end only what the stop refusal lists.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Held work (LESSONS §376) is sent again only in a turn that follows a go-word.
rules.says: Held work is sent again only in a turn that follows a go-word.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A task notification, a scheduled message and an agent's hand-back are not
rules.says: A task notification, a scheduled message and an agent's hand-back are not messages from the owner and do not count as owner messages for the correction check.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A message the harness never delivered is printed once,
rules.says: A message the harness never delivered is printed once, word for word, at the top of the turn of the prompt that overtook it, and the session answers it there.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A
rules.says: A message the queue loses is no longer held against every call once a message typed after it has arrived as a prompt, so the hold does not persist for the rest of the session.
